messages:
sam: Quick post-soak note: compaction held the global compact lock and added ~90ms to tenant B microbatches.

maria: ouch. log?

sam: short snippet:
```
[2026-04-02T11:03:12Z] compact: arena=2 acquired-global-compact-lock
[2026-04-02T11:03:12Z] tenant=B microbatch wait_for_alloc=92ms
```

jin: current compactor aggregates metrics under the global lock; expensive. two options: cooperative slicing or emergency reserve pool for tiny allocations.

alex: +1 to combining both. reserve should be token-gated per-tenant (token-bucket).

maria: ops asks dry-run telemetry first and auto-disable if abuse >90th pct.

sam: plan: land reserve_soft API (dry-run) -> add telemetry -> implement compactor slices -> enable guards. i'll open RFC follow-up.

infra-bot: CI green for branch "reserve-soft-dryrun"
